items.title: How does asking more genuine discovery questions change deal size?
items.description: This models the pattern behind Adri and Bex's calls: at 0 questions asked (pitching straight to the stated ask), the deal size sits at the $4,800/year plan Priya originally inquired about. Each additional genuinely open discovery question raises the ceiling, as more of the real problem's scope gets surfaced — but with diminishing returns, since only so much real scope exists to find. At the default of 4 questions (matching Bex's actual call), the model lands close to the $28,800 multi-team plan Bex actually closed. Drag the slider past that point to see how much further scope-widening tends to slow down once the real problem has mostly been surfaced.

params.name: questionsAsked
params.label: Genuine open discovery questions asked before pitching

items.compute: const base = 4800; const cap = 36000; const k = 0.35; const dealSize = base + (cap - base) * (1 - Math.exp(-k * params.questionsAsked)); return { dealSize: Math.round(dealSize) };
